Name: Jehoram, King of Israel
Summary: Jehoram, also called Joram, son of Ahab, put away Baal's image but clung to Jeroboam's sins, warred with Moab alongside Jehoshaphat, and was slain by Jehu at Jezreel.
KeyStory: Jehoram wars with Moab and is slain by Jehu.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; Jezebel; Mesha, King of Moab; King Jehoshaphat; Jehu, King of Israel; Ahaziah, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Half a reform is no reform: Jehoram removed an image and kept the idolatry.
